subject: Inflight surge: quick deployment-mode qualification and next steps
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finclick.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@finclick.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: spike and immediate needs

Thanks again for taking the call. Quick recap from our side and why we're flagging this as urgent:

- Yesterday night at ~23:01 UTC we saw a sustained request-rate spike (3x baseline) for our fraud-modeling endpoint; latency climbed from p50 80ms -> p95 1.4s and we began seeing 503s after ~8 minutes. (attached: error_snippet_080142.txt)
- Our customer ops SLA requires <500ms 95th for realtime decisions; this event put us at risk for ~10% of traffic.

Immediate ask: we need a recommendation for an action path — keep us on Hosted with mitigation, spin up Dedicated capacity, or move to a Private VPC for isolation. We need an estimate of:

1) time-to-ramp (how quickly can Dedicated capacity be provisioned to handle peak X TPS)
2) expected cost delta for a short-term Dedicated pilot (2-4 weeks) vs immediate Hosted autoscale
3) if Private VPC is the only viable option given data residency and logs retention (we have some compliance constraints)

Can you confirm the fastest path and what you need from us (traffic patterns, sample token sizes, retention windows) to scope a pilot?

Thanks — Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Platform, FinClick
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finclick.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@finclick.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: spike and immediate needs

Alex — appreciate the clear summary. Short answers up front, then a quick list of what we need to scope: 

Short recommendation (based on initial info):
- Short-term (hours -> 24h): keep on Hosted but route high-risk flows to a pre-warmed Dedicated pool as a stop-gap. This minimizes immediate outage risk.
- Short-to-mid (2–4 weeks): run a Dedicated pilot sized for your 95th percentile + 25% headroom.
- Long-term (if retention/compliance requires): Private VPC is appropriate; can be done in parallel but provisioning timelines are longer (2–6 weeks depending on network setup).

Quick clarifying questions (please send):
- Peak TPS and average token lengths for the endpoint(s) that hit the spike.
- Percent of traffic that must meet <500ms p95 SLA (is it 100% or a subset?)
- Data retention/PII constraints and KMS requirements for Private option.
- Whether a short maintenance window is acceptable for cutover testing.

What we can do on our side now:
- I can create a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with timelines for Dedicated pilot + Private option and a one-page cost delta. I attached a MAP_v0.3.pdf stub for review.
- I'll loop Ben (SE) to validate the performance numbers and draft the Dedicated pool sizing.

Proposed immediate next steps (today):
1) FinClick provides peak TPS and token profile (ideally CSV sample).
2) Redwood SE (Ben) runs a quick sizing analysis and returns a recommended Dedicated config within 6-8 business hours.
3) Decide whether to authorize a pre-warmed Dedicated pilot (we can do a short-term chargeable pilot while we prepare Private VPC if needed).

If you want we can also schedule a 30-min deep-dive today at 18:30 PT.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finclick.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@finclick.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-call: spike and immediate needs

Looping Ben in to validate sizing and to own the pilot runbook. Ben — see Alex's snippet and Diego's recommendations below. Key constraints: FinClick needs p95 <500ms for the fraud endpoint and cannot tolerate >1% error rate during peak windows. They are open to a short Dedicated pilot while we concurrently design a Private VPC if KMS/networking requires it.

Ben — suggested immediate playbook:
- Today: quick sizing from traces (Diego -> FinClick to share CSV). Target quick-sim sizing for Dedicated (estimate in 6-8 hours).
- If sizing looks good: spin up a 48–72 hour pre-warmed Dedicated pool with autoscale disabled (to test behavior under load).
- During pilot: enable prefix/KV caching, strict batching config, and collection of token-level latencies.
- Parallel work: legal/procurement starts expedited SOW/DocuSign for pilot (Diego, please send draft).

Deliverables and owners:
- Sizing & bench (Ben) — deploy perf run and share results + config snippet (pilot_config.yaml)
- MAP + cost delta (Diego) — finalize MAP_v0.3.pdf and include estimated pilot charge
- Private VPC checklist (Marissa) — initial network/KMS questions for FinClick

Alex/Sanjay — two asks from you to unblock today:
1) Upload a 30-minute traffic sample (CSV) to the HubSpot link: https://redwood.app/hubspot/record/FC-8421
2) Confirm whether FinClick has an internal maintenance window if we need brief cutover testing (yes/no)

I created a follow-up Jira ticket: JIRA-INF-558 and attached a lightweight pilot_config.yaml for Ben to iterate. I'll also open an expedited DocuSign envelope for the pilot SOW and share the link once ready.

Thanks — we should be able to get a recommended Dedicated config within the day and spin a pilot within 24–48 hours pending PO.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachments referenced: pilot_config.yaml, MAP_v0.3.pdf
